blockers.symptom: Malformed component recovery can grant an unearned advanced state or cause an authoritative resource debit that the model then refuses to apply.
evidence: The orphan-advance probe changes a registered seed target to foundation/revision 1 with no receipt; import_component_state returns true and the foundation-to-reinforced preview passes.

The pending-cost probe changes a prepared wood debit from 8 to 1, recomputes the public request key, and imports successfully; simulation debits 1 wood and 4 stone, then the model rejects the receipt as receipt_debit_mismatch, leaving resources charged and the target at seed.

import_component_state checks row shape and local target/revision relationships but does not require every positive-revision target to have a completed receipt and does not bind imported transaction rows to configured recipe costs, endpoints, tags, or presentation key.
The existing 320-check deterministic C7 proof does not contain either hostile recovery case; the final independent C7 report scores recovery_integrity 4.0 after reproducing the partial charge.
blockers.root_cause: Component import treats self-consistent caller-controlled transaction dictionaries as sufficient recovery authority instead of re-deriving their semantic fields from the configured recipe catalog and enforcing the target-to-latest-receipt invariant before recovered work can reach simulation authority.
blockers.affected_object: T10 component recovery, exact-once debit atomicity, and progression integrity
blockers.causal_fix: Before mutating live state, validate every persisted prepared and completed row against its configured recipe: exact recipe identity, source/target states, canonical costs, progression tags, presentation key, request identity and authority key. Require every target with revision greater than zero to have exactly one matching latest completed receipt; preserve legitimate revision-zero, pending-first, advanced-with-receipt, and advanced-with-receipt-plus-next-pending states. Reject the entire import atomically on any mismatch.
verification: Both independent hostile probes reject with the complete previously populated component state unchanged and zero simulation-resource mutation.
Mutating each recipe-bound field in prepared and completed rows rejects atomically, including cost, endpoint, tag, presentation key, recipe ID, request identity and authority key.
Valid revision-zero, first pending, completed, completed-plus-next-pending, replay, crash recovery and JSON round-trip states still import and resolve exactly once.
The task C7 runner requires named orphan-advance and recipe-bound recovered-pending checks and all domain/integration checks pass.
